scope: Reconstructed motor-only Mandaue experiments. Separate from the interactive browser queue model. Not field results or trained RL.

audit.canonical_native_outputs: SHA256-checked complete .xml.gz mirrors captured immediately after SUMO close; XML parsed and trip accounting recomputed independently.
audit.note: Output/accounting checks and finite motor-only diagnostics, not field/pedestrian acceptance.

protocol.selection: Existing transparent rule fixed before these measurements; no fitting or learned-checkpoint selection.
protocol.primary: Study-cohort mean accumulated scheduled-to-exit time at common cutoff, including unfinished and uninserted trips; a restricted lower bound, not an estimate of eventual travel time.
secondary: incoming-approach halting vehicles and farthest-stopped tail extent
protocol.source_scope: Team manual hourly class/site marginals; reconstructed routes/arrival times and conditional fixed signal program; lane-based motor-only model.
protocol.queue_definition: Incoming approach halting count at speed <=0.1 m/s sampled every5s; tail extent is distance from lane end to rearmost stopped vehicle rear on modeled incoming edges. Exact SUMO state is evaluation-only.
protocol.acceptance: Finite motor-only simulation diagnostics, not full Table4 field/pedestrian acceptance. Any collision/teleport is retained and flagged; no failed seed removed.

audit.canonical_native_outputs: SHA256-checked complete .xml.gz mirrors captured immediately after SUMO close; XML parsed and trip accounting recomputed independently.
audit.note: Output/accounting checks and finite motor-only diagnostics, not field/pedestrian acceptance.

audit.phase_checks: Native event states checked independently: minimum green, full yellow/all-red, request-bound priority jumps and cyclic ordinary return.

protocol.demand: Original full-count background plus ONE identical controlled probe in every arm; not an observed emergency incident.

source.selection: Shortest existing simple three-site journey containing A. Soriano/Ouano through movement; local probes use its matching movement visits. Selected geometrically before performance runs.

protocol.stopping: After 4200 and EV arrival, else 14400; incomplete EVs remain censored.

beacon.position_model: Exact SUMO coordinates as ideal GNSS fixes; no sampled position noise or physical RF measurement.
beacon.cap_semantics: Elapsed from first accepted request INCLUDING transition time. No renewal for the same site encounter.

protocol.control: Protected stage transfer after >=10s green, 4s yellow, 4s all red; no abrupt conflicting green. Cyclic local operation resumes on release. No pedestrian inputs in this motor-only test.
protocol.EV_behavior: Same passenger-class 5m/2m ordinary driver proxy in all arms, emergency GUI shape only; no bluelight device, red-light exemption, speed/lane mode override or teleport.

audit.phase_checks: Native event states checked independently: minimum green, full yellow/all-red, request-bound priority jumps and cyclic ordinary return.
